_why: The URL words a PUBLIC page may honour (render/core/main.gd URL_ARGS minus LOCAL_ONLY_ARGS), reviewed: Legal's RL-196 (2026-10-27) and the EP's addition (2). They are look switches; none touches the notice, the lock or any flashing option. tools/site-routes.mjs fails on any other word a public page would honour, so a new URL word is gated local-only (LOCAL_ONLY_ARGS) or reviewed here, and a change to these four runs the flash clips like any look change.

_public.skyreact: the clouds part at tier 3 and 4 (off unless asked for)
_public.panhaze: the buildings' haze while the camera travels fast: on
_public.keyhelp: the greybox key prompt and key help

_bypass: words that start a run with no gate or no intro: they must be in LOCAL_ONLY_ARGS (dropped on a public page); bench, frames, shot and nonotice are not URL words at all (ui/hud/ui_hud.gd BYPASS_WORDS reads them from the command line and honours them only on a local host).
